'''Thunder Peak''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anoth/Legends|Anoth]]. It possessed a deep grotto system where the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] built a secure, operational facility known as [[Anoth Base]]. The installation was designed to ensure the safety of the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] children; [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], and [[Anakin Solo|Anakin]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
